arabic text: FIZZANE KAHAA AUNO MUHAMMED GAE MAARE\nDARIYAAKE KANAARE
english translation text: FIZZA SAID, AUN AND MUHAMMAD HAVE\nBEEN MARTYRED, AT THE RIVER BANK

arabic text: FIZZANE KAHAA AUNO MUHAMMED GAE MAARE DARIYAAKE KANAARE\nMAAMUPE FIDAA HOGAE ZAINABKE DULHAARE DARIYAA KE KANAARE
english translation text: FIZZA SAID, AUN AND MUHAMMAD HAVE BEEN MARTYRED, AT THE RIVER BANK,\nZAINAB’S PRINCES HAVE SACRIFICED THEMSELVES FOR THEIR UNCLE, AT THE RIVER BANK

arabic text:
SUNKER YE SADAA SAANIE SEHRAA YE PUKAARI
AMMAA GAI WAARI
PYAASEHI MERE LAADLE DUNIYAASE SIDHAARE
DARIYAAKE KANAARE
english translation text:
WHEN ZAINAB HEARD THIS,
SHE SAID O MOTHER,
MY SONS WERE KILLED WHILE THEY WERE THIRSTY,
AT THE RIVER BANK

arabic text:
DEKHENGE NA PAANIKI TARAF AANKH UTHAAKE
WAA-A-DA THAA YE MAASE
DARIYAAKE KANAARE
SHEHZAADONE DAM TOD DIYAA PYAASKE MAARE
english translation text:
WE WILL NOT EVEN LIFT OUR EYES TO LOOK AT THE WATER,
THIS WAS THE PROMISE THEY MADE TO THEIR MOTHER,
THE PRINCES DIED THIRSTY,
AT THE RIVER BANK

arabic text:
KHAIMEN MEN ABHI LAANEKI JALDI NAHI LOGO
AKBERSE YE KEHDO
BACHCHONKO MERE BHAAI KA SADQAA TO UTAARE
DARIYAAKE KANAARE
english translation text:
DO NOT BE IN A HURRY TO BRING BACK THEIR BODIES TO THE TENTS,
TELL AKBAR THIS,
LET MY SONS BE SACRIFICED FOR MY BROTHER,
AT THE RIVER BANK

arabic text:
ACHCHHAA HAI KE SOTE RAHE HUNH KHAAKPE RAKKHE
ABBAASKE QADMON MEN RAHE LAAL HAMAARE
DARIYAAKE KANAARE
SAAYE MEN ALAMKE
english translation text:
IT IS BETTER IF THEY KEEP SLEEPING ON THE SAND,
IN THE SHADOW OF THE ALAM (FLAG),
LET THEM LIE AT THE FEET OF ABBAS,
AT THE RIVER BANK
